339-677-1849-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-1849-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3995-5268-7008.easyPrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab doesn't have summoning sickness.
3995-5268-7008.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

687-2034-4613-8130-8136.description:
Cast Biomathematician by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Biomathematician enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with a vigilance counter due to Tayam, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Fractal you control.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Fractal token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Biomathematician and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Biomathematician from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-4613-8130-8136.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

1479-2841-6529-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-6529-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2358-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
2358-6034-8089.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and 1 life, adding {B}
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1170-5131-5226-7693--202.easyPrerequisites:
Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-7693--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Armor Wars.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1621-1895-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1618-3617-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
1618-3617-7757.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing the time counters from Time Walk.
Time Walk's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1809-2103-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2445-3967-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

4742-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

725-1329-1778-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Memnite, adding {R}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Memnite, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

2441-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Rasputin and Icewind Stalwart.
Cast Rasputin from exile by paying {2}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Activate Rasputin's first ability seven times by removing seven dream counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {2}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4771-5660-6289.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1369-5724-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Sage of the Maze.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Sage of the Maze's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Sage of the Maze's ability by tapping it, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Sage of the Maze's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

104-3490-4050-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-5789.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2232-2792-6797-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2792-6797-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

1168-1651-1770-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-1770-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-1770-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2169-4659-5003-6554.manaNeeded: {G}{U} plus {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
2169-4659-5003-6554.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2523-5559.description:
Cast Nazgûl by paying {2}{B}.
Nazgûl enters, triggering  its first activated ability and Blasting Station.
Resolve Blasting Station's ability, untapping it.
Resolve Nazgûl's ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Nazgûl.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Resolve the ability from step 6, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-3504.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Mercurial Pretender.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Mercurial Pretender and another permanent you control.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

5477-5629-5630-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
5477-5629-5630-5631.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself on top of your library.
Skeleton Crew and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
When the Skeleton Pirate enters the battlefield, Snarling Gorehound triggers, causing you to surveil 1, putting Moss-Pit Skeleton into your graveyard from the top of your library.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton and Snarling Gorehound trigger.
Resolve the Snarling Gorehound trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Moss-Pit Skeleton trigger, putting it on top of your library.
Repeat from step 3.

703-1308-2726.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Astral Dragon spell.
Resolve the copy of the Astral Dragon spell, putting one token copy of Astral Dragon onto the battlefield (note this is not "created" so it is not doubled).
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating four token copies of Anointed Procession that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the original Astral Dragon spell from step 1.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating 64 token copies of Anointed Procession that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

4050-4516-5254.notablePrerequisites:
There have been a number of permanents sacrificed this turn equal to five plus The Balrog's commander tax.
You do not control an Army.
4050-4516-5254.description:
Cast The Balrog from the command zone by paying {B}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Balrog, adding {B}.
Choose to return The Balrog to the command zone from your graveyard.
When The Balrog dies, it and Warbeast of Gorgoroth trigger.
Resolve the Balrog trigger, destroying any artifact and/or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Warbeast of Gorgoroth trigger, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token, and then putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1429-1636-2204-4050.notablePrerequisites: Scholar of New Horizons does not have summoning sickness.
1429-1636-2204-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding one mana of any color.
Lesser Masticore dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Scholar of New Horizons by tapping it and removing the -1/-1 counter from Lesser Masticore, causing you to search your library for a Plains card and either put it onto the battlefield or put it into your hand.
Repeat.

224-1257-1373-3875-4482.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1257-1373-3875-4482.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Walking Atlas and choosing either to untap another creature or scry 1.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, giving a creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

3048-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Roalesk.
Roalesk enters the battlefield, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may target other creatures with Roalesk's trigger.

379-3258.notablePrerequisites:
Varragoth does not have summoning sickness.
Varragoth cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
379-3258.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Declare Varragoth as an attacker.
Activate Varragoth's boast ability by paying {1}{B}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat.

3542-5140-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
3542-5140-5256.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Palinchron, causing target player to mill cards equal to Palinchron's power.
Repeat.

1174-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
1174-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Walk the Aeons on top of your library.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand, untapping any land.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

770-2397-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {3}{U}.
770-2397-3821.description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon.
Resolve one Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the remaining Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {3}{U}.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying {2}{U}.
When Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon, returning itself and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 4, this combo produces infinite mana.

813-1518-1987-5116.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
813-1518-1987-5116.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

92-4996.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
92-4996.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
